title: Detailed birthday cake with candles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='40' ry='7' fill='#c0d8f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#e8f4ff'/>

  <!-- bottom cake layer -->
  <rect x='18' y='68' width='64' height='18' rx='4' fill='#f7c8a0'/>
  <rect x='18' y='68' width='64' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- frosting drips bottom -->
  <path d='M18 73 Q23 80 28 73 Q33 80 38 73 Q43 80 48 73 Q53 80 58 73 Q63 80 68 73 Q73 80 78 73 L82 73 L82 68 L18 68 Z' fill='#ff9ec4'/>

  <!-- middle cake layer -->
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='52' height='17' rx='4' fill='#f7b088'/>
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='52' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffd26e'/>
  <!-- frosting drips middle -->
  <path d='M24 57 Q28 63 32 57 Q36 63 40 57 Q44 63 48 57 Q52 63 56 57 Q60 63 64 57 Q68 63 72 57 L76 57 L76 52 L24 52 Z' fill='#ffd26e'/>

  <!-- top cake layer -->
  <rect x='30' y='38' width='40' height='15' rx='4' fill='#f7a870'/>
  <rect x='30' y='38' width='40' height='5' rx='2' fill='#7be87b'/>
  <!-- frosting drips top -->
  <path d='M30 43 Q33 48 36 43 Q39 48 42 43 Q45 48 48 43 Q51 48 54 43 Q57 48 60 43 Q63 48 66 43 L70 43 L70 38 L30 38 Z' fill='#7be87b'/>

  <!-- sprinkles bottom -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='80' r='1.2' fill='#ff5e5e'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='82' r='1.2' fill='#5e9eff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='79' r='1.2' fill='#ffe55e'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='81' r='1.2' fill='#b45eff'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='84' r='1.2' fill='#7be87b'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='84' r='1.2' fill='#ff9ec4'/>

  <!-- sprinkles middle -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='62' r='1' fill='#5e9eff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='64' r='1' fill='#ff5e5e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='61' r='1' fill='#7be87b'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='63' r='1' fill='#ffe55e'/>

  <!-- candles -->
  <!-- candle 1 -->
  <rect x='36' y='24' width='4' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#5e9eff'/>
  <rect x='36' y='28' width='4' height='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffe55e'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='21' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8c1a'/>

  <!-- candle 2 -->
  <rect x='48' y='22' width='4' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <rect x='48' y='26' width='4' height='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffe55e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='19' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8c1a'/>

  <!-- candle 3 -->
  <rect x='60' y='24' width='4' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#7be87b'/>
  <rect x='60' y='28' width='4' height='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='22' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffe55e'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='21' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8c1a'/>

  <!-- flames glow -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='21' r='5' fill='#ffe55e' opacity='0.15'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='19' r='5' fill='#ffe55e' opacity='0.15'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='21' r='5' fill='#ffe55e' opacity='0.15'/>

  <!-- cherry on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='4' fill='#ff4d4d'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ffb3b3'/>

  <!-- wick stems -->
  <line x1='38' y1='26' x2='38' y2='24' stroke='#3d3d3d' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='50' y2='22' stroke='#3d3d3d' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='26' x2='62' y2='24' stroke='#3d3d3d' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
